instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md from origin/agent-control before execution.
Read RADAR_4060_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md completely and treat it as the authoritative implementation plan for this task.
Verify upstream alibaba-damo-academy/damo-radar main contains exact commit 0dbf0ece209b77d722588e5e7943014d3db48f7f; do not silently substitute a newer commit.

Using the authenticated GitHub CLI already configured on the local workstation, create private repository nghoang1288/RADAR-4060 if it does not already exist. If it already exists, inspect it and continue only if it is clearly this project; otherwise mark blocked.
Clone/import the pinned upstream state, preserve LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, set an upstream remote, and push the pinned baseline to target main.
Create working branch antigravity/radar-4060-bootstrap from the exact pinned baseline.
Copy the implementation plan into docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md in the target repository.
Implement the 8GB inference memory path described in the plan without reducing the upstream default ROI or quantizing model weights.
Prefer a dedicated RADAR_inference/inference_4060.py entry point while reusing upstream code rather than duplicating the project.

Keep the full CT and full-volume stitching accumulators on CPU; transfer only the active patch to CUDA; use inference_mode and optional FP16 autocast; return patch outputs to CPU immediately; use a one-channel overlap count map.
Create a minimal inference dependency file and WSL helper scripts. Do not install unrelated training packages merely because they are in the upstream monolithic requirements.txt.
Use only the upstream public demo NIfTI for end-to-end testing. Do not use any local patient data.
Profile baseline and optimized paths. Record peak allocated/reserved CUDA memory, runtime, relevant package versions, and numerical differences against upstream demo/reference output when available.
Add synthetic regression tests for stitching equivalence, one-channel count-map broadcasting, AMP off mode, and the invariant that full-volume 37-channel accumulators are not CUDA-resident.
If optimized inference still OOMs, do not hide the failure or reduce ROI silently. Profile the remaining peak and document the precise blocker and next memory target.
Write docs/BENCHMARK.md with aggregate non-PHI results.
Push only code, docs, scripts, tests and aggregate benchmark data to the target repository. Keep checkpoints and generated model outputs Git-ignored.
Open a pull request from antigravity/radar-4060-bootstrap to main after tests. Do not merge it.
Push the terminal receipt/result for this control task back to nghoang1288/Prima agent-control according to the bridge protocol.
suggested_commands: gh repo create nghoang1288/RADAR-4060 --private --description "RTX 4060 8GB research inference port of Alibaba DAMO RADAR"

acceptance: Target private repository nghoang1288/RADAR-4060 exists or an explicit blocker explains why gh could not create it
Target main is based on exact upstream SHA 0dbf0ece209b77d722588e5e7943014d3db48f7f with upstream attribution and licenses preserved
docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md exists in the target repository
Optimized inference keeps full-volume stitching on CPU and preserves upstream default ROI
Public demo inference completes on RTX 4060 8GB without CUDA OOM OR the result contains a precise measured blocker
docs/BENCHMARK.md records exact runtime environment, peak VRAM, runtime and numerical comparison
No patient-derived files or PHI are committed
A pull request is opened but not merged
Terminal result is pushed to .antigravity/results/RADAR-20260922-001.json on agent-control
